text:
Anya: Quick sync — post-call notes from CanoeHealth onboarding this morning. They dropped 3 product asks that map to renewal risk if not addressed.
Anya: TL;DR: visibility into per-route usage/cost, clearer onboarding docs for Private deployments, and a small UX tweak for the tokenized billing export.
Sam: Can you paste the verbatim asks? Need to triage against roadmap & quick wins.
Anya: Sure — pasted from their CSM notes: 
- 'We need per-route cost breakdown in Console so finance can reconcile pilot usage with our billing system.'
- 'On-prem install checklist + expected timelines — security needs this to approve prod access.'
- 'CSV export for tokenized billing should include route name and customer ref so we can import into our ERP.'
Li: Sounds like two high-impact ops items and one product CSV field add. The on-prem checklist might be a legal/compliance ask too.
Anya: Yep, they explicitly said approval is blocked without the checklist. They asked for a one-pager by next Wed.
Sam: Prioritization proposal: 1) On-prem checklist (blocking approval) — P0 for next-week deliverable (doc only). 2) Per-route cost visibility — P1: scoped as Console UI + backend metrics, could be MVP with CSV export/proxy. 3) CSV field add — P2, quick engineering task.
Li: For per-route cost visibility, we can stitch existing per-route counters and expose them in the billing export in ~2 sprints if we do CSV-first.
Anya: Customer asked for a temporary workaround: a scheduled CSV that our CSM can push weekly. That reduces short-term risk.
Sam: OK — immediate actions: 
- Anya: share the exact security checklist items CanoeHealth needs (deadline Wed).
- Li: scope CSV export to include route name + customer_ref and estimate effort (can you do an initial PR by EOD Fri?).
- Sam: I'll slot 'on-prem one-pager' for product comms (I'll draft and share by Tue).
triage-bot: New feedback ticket created: FB-2026-998 (linked in internal tracker).
Anya: FYI — they also mentioned pain around 'ambiguous error codes' during Private deploys that slow SRE. Not captured as feature ask but a quality-of-life item.
Sam: Noted. Add to QUALITY backlog and assign to eng runtime team for investigation.
Li: Quick question — do we have any existing docs for on-prem checklist that we can adapt?
Anya: There's an old internal runbook under /playbooks/private-deployments but it's out of date. I can pull the relevant bits for the one-pager.
Sam: Great. Once we have the checklist draft, I'll loop in Legal for any phrasing we need for audits.
Anya: I'll also ask the CSM to confirm whether weekly CSV is sufficient as a stopgap — will report back. :thumbsup:
Li: If anyone needs me to spike a CSV-export branch, ping me and I can start tomorrow.
Sam: Thank you team — this one looks like a classic 'prevent churn through docs + small data export'. Let's treat checklist as highest urgency.
Anya: Adding final note — customer sentiment: 'wanting clarity and fast answers, not big product changes'. So low-friction deliverables are key.
Sam: Copy. I'll update the roadmap playbook and mark FB-2026-998 as high priority for CS -> Product handoff.
Anya: closing loop — I'll put the checklist items into the ticket and tag you both.
Li: :eyes:
Anya: Thanks all.
